title: Around the World in Eighty Days
blurb: A wager, a timetable, and Phileas Fogg counting his steps. The first translation, made the year after the French edition.

rights.basis: author d. 1905; first published 1872 — public domain in India (life + 60) and the United States (pre-1930); translation by George Makepeace Towle (d. 1893), first published 1873 — public domain in India (life + 60) and the United States (pre-1930)

translator.name: George Makepeace Towle
translator.source: Wikipedia, George Makepeace Towle — died 9 August 1893, Brookline, Massachusetts; translated Verne's Around the World in Eighty Days, 1873
